title: feat(hrk1): height-ridge same-k holds at k=1: t=3 vs t=5
science: Introduces height-ridge zeta = rho3 + cost 3 on a 3->3 hop whose destination has exactly two coordinates at the minimum m with m>=2. At k=1 on B_6: t=3 vs 5, 27>25. The note itself certifies the new clause is IDLE on this host ('no nearest-neighbor hop inside B_6(0) has |sigma_v|=|sigma_w|=3 and exactly two destination coordinates equal to a minimum of at least 2'), so the PR is a re-run of rho3's
